lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Hello, Kaveri Finance la irundhu pesaren. Senthil Kumar irukkaaraa?

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: அவர் வெளிய போயிருக்காரு. நான் அவர் wife பேசறேன். யாரு நீங்க?
lines.roman: Avar veliya poyirukkaaru. Naan avar wife pesaren. Yaaru neenga?

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Madam, unga husband bike loan EMI innum kattala, rendu vaaram aachu. Avara udane enakku call panna sollunga.

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: இருங்க, அவரே வந்துட்டாரு... Hello, Senthil பேசறேன். என் wife கிட்ட ஏன் loan பத்தி சொல்றீங்க?
lines.roman: Irunga, avare vandhuttaaru... Hello, Senthil pesaren. En wife kitta yen loan patthi solreenga?

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Neenga phone edukkala sir, adhaan. Three thousand nine hundred rupees EMI, November second due. Yen innum kattala?

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: இந்த மாசம் கடை ல business ரொம்ப down. அடுத்த மாசம் தான் முடியும்.
lines.roman: Indha maasam kadai la business romba down. Adutha maasam dhaan mudiyum.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Adhellam enakku theriyadhu sir, ellaarum idhe kadhai dhaan solraanga. Late aana five hundred rupees late fee um varum, CIBIL score um kedum.

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: Sir, மரியாதையா பேசுங்க. நான் வேணும்னு கட்டாம இல்ல.
lines.roman: Sir, mariyaadhaiya pesunga. Naan venumnu kattaama illa.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Indha week pay pannala na, namma field team unga veetukku varuvaanga, street la ellaarukkum theriyum. Legal notice um varum.

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: இப்படி மிரட்டுனா ஒரு rupee கூட கட்ட மாட்டேன். Complaint பண்ணுவேன்.
lines.roman: Ippadi mirattuna oru rupee kooda katta maatten. Complaint pannuven.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Panni paarunga sir. Indha week kattalana bike um seize pannuvom.

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: சரி பண்ணுங்க. நான் இப்போ pay பண்ண மாட்டேன். Phone வைக்கிறேன்.
lines.roman: Seri pannunga. Naan ippo pay panna maatten. Phone vaikkiren.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Seri sir, apparam ungalukku dhaan problem.

analysis.outcomeRationale: After being threatened with a home visit, legal notice and bike seizure, the customer refused to pay and ended the call.
analysis.summary: Agent disclosed the overdue EMI to the borrower's wife before reaching him, then dismissed his business-slowdown reason and threatened a field visit, legal notice and repossession. The borrower, who had offered to pay next month, refused outright and said he would complain.
analysis.observations: Serious RBI fair-practice breaches: third-party disclosure to the spouse, threats of home visit with public shaming, legal action and seizure, and dismissive language. The customer was recoverable (offered next month) until the threats.
analysis.improvements: Never discuss the loan with anyone but the verified borrower; ask for a callback time instead. Acknowledge the slowdown and convert 'next month' into a dated PTP or part-payment. Mandatory compliance coaching and call review before further collections calls.

op_greet_company.rationale: Named Kaveri Finance in the opening, though without a proper greeting.

op_rpc_verify.rationale: Discussed the overdue EMI with the wife without verifying the borrower.

pr_state_dues.rationale: Stated the ₹3,900 EMI and the 2 November due date to the borrower.

pr_late_fee_info.rationale: Mentioned the ₹500 late fee and CIBIL impact, though in a dismissive tone.

ds_reason_delay.rationale: Asked why the EMI was not paid.

ds_empathy.rationale: Dismissed the business slowdown as 'the same story everyone tells'.

cp_no_threats.rationale: Threatened a field-team home visit, neighbourhood shaming, legal notice and bike seizure.

cp_respectful.rationale: Dismissive remarks; customer had to ask the agent to speak respectfully.

cp_no_third_party.rationale: Disclosed the overdue loan to the borrower's wife.

cl_ptp_secured.rationale: Customer refused to pay; no promise obtained.

cl_recap.rationale: Call ended on a dismissive remark with no recap.

moments.label: Threatened home visit and legal notice
